messages.subject: [Viennar-meetup] Vienna - R 2019 February
messages.body_plain:
I am happy to announce the meetup for February with the following
presentations,

Peter Jeitschko:
"Self Service Data Preparation und Data Science."
Alteryx eine f?hrende Analytics Platform die es Benutzern aus dem
Fachbereich wie auch Data Scientist erm?glicht, Erkenntinisse aus Daten zu
gewinnen.


Christoph Bodner + Thomas Laber:
"Serverless computing with AWS for data science"

Florian Schwendinger:
"grpc + xmlrpc in R"

The meetup will take place
on
Tuesday, February 12, 2019 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM
at
Seminarraum D4.0.127 (Vienna University of Economics - Welthandelsplatz 1).

Best,
Florian
